name: TommyLeePeeca
archetype: CS2 in-play market maker (switched from taker mid-October)
headline: Changed strategy inside the month. Until mid-October it took liquidity in live CS2 matches and lost money before rebates; since 16-17 October it quotes both sides of live CS2 markets and earns the spread, about $89.5k per 30 days without rebates. That maker strategy has only 13 days of history and a public-data maker loses money in the same matches.
mechanism: Over the whole 30 days 87% of sampled fills are maker fills, but none before 16 October and nearly all after. Settled PnL $27,145 splits into realized losses on sells -$67,231, locked pair spread $55,481 and residual $38,896. Maker regime (17-29 October, 13 days): $43,699, every day positive, pair cost about 0.98. Taker regime (30 September - 15 October): -$6,146 after fees, positive only because of a $21,621 taker rebate.

roc.detail: 629%/month: 30-day PnL $60,279 on peak capital at risk $9,577; counting the on-chain collateral too ($52,202), at least 98%/month

onchain.detail: 200/200 sampled fills confirmed in Polygon OrderFilled events; 87% maker fills (95% CI 82%-90%), 48% of USDC

match.detail: a reviewer tape-only fingerprint (it keeps bids pegged while the price falls, where other makers pull) matches its maker fills on 60 fresh markets: AUC 0.541, p=0.002, specific to this wallet, but lift 1.2; five other public rules do not match

backtest.detail: 30-day split: tape-only two-sided maker on 80 held-out markets -8.3% to -9.3% at 0-30 s (strict), -7.5% to -8.6% at 0-5 s with first-in-queue fills; the wallet's own passive fills there +1.9% (p=0.056); maker regime only (FIT/TEST inside 17-29 October): tape-only two-sided maker on 100 held-out markets -5.7% to -8.8% at 0-30 s (strict), -5.0% to -6.5% at 0-5 s with first-in-queue fills; the wallet's own passive fills there +0.1% (p=0.47); six reviewer rules (momentum taker, favourite / momentum-lean / post-drop / between-rounds / inventory-balancing makers) all lose held out

replicable.detail: the symmetric public-data maker loses even at zero latency with first-in-queue fills; the edge needs game-state information faster than the public tape, and live CS2 round feeds (Polymarket's own score field, HLTV) have no history to test against. The old taker regime depended on the Obsidian rebate (observed taker-rebate tier Obsidian (50% of fees); 30-day PnL at the 0% tier $32,894, Gold $42,706, Diamond $56,879, Obsidian $60,150)

persistence.detail: the current maker strategy has 13 days of history, too short to establish that it persists (stage A1 needs 60 days before the ranking window); the whole-wallet tests pass only by mixing two strategies. last 30 days p=0.013; decline vs earlier p=0.48; last 15 vs prior 15 p=0.90; trend p=0.83

reasons: The profitable strategy (CS2 market making) is only 13 days old: persistence cannot be established.
A public-data maker loses in the same matches, including inside the maker regime.
No public rule reproduces its quoting beyond a weak fingerprint.
corrections: The earlier mechanism ('leaning quotes toward the side that wins rounds', locked -$50k, residual +$137k) came from counting sells as purchases; sell-aware, locked spread is the largest positive part.
The earlier rebate-dependence reason belongs to the old taker regime; the maker regime does not depend on the rebate.
The 30-day FIT/TEST split fell on the regime change (FIT had almost no maker fills); the maker regime is now tested on its own.
